title: Cosmic Futures Laboratory: a numerical laboratory for conditional cosmological futures
description: Version 0.1.0 research software preview. An interactive homogeneous FLRW simulator with adaptive numerical integration, conservative dark-matter-to-radiation transfers, conditional extreme-time asymptotes, astrophysical tracers, seeded uncertainty sampling, scientific references and reproducible exports. It does not calculate a unique actual cosmic fate, run an N-body model or fit an observational likelihood. Methodology and limitations are documented in the archive.
